instruction: In clients/claude-code/installer.go, the error for a downloaded release asset whose checksum does not match begins "sha256 mismatch for". Make it begin "SHA-256 mismatch for" instead, keeping the rest of the message. Change nothing else.

require.match: fmt\.Errorf\("SHA-256 mismatch for %s: release lists %s, download is %s — the file is not the one the release published", asset, want\[:12\], got\[:12\]\)
